name: Trail of the Wretched
source:
Trail of the Wretched is a bleak visual novel set on a fictional continent inspired by the old west. You play as a photographer sent across the ocean to capture the New World in all its untamed and horrible beauty.

You'll argue with the voices in your head, witness unspeakable acts, cross rivers, acquire a fancy new coat, put your head in a noose, and maybe, just maybe, you'll say something profound.

[From [url=https://xavibell.itch.io/trail-of-the-wretched]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《苦难之途》是一部基调冷峻苍凉的视觉小说，背景设定在一片以美国旧西部为灵感的虚构大陆。你将扮演一名受命远渡重洋的摄影师，用镜头定格这片新大陆狂野不羁而又骇人听闻的壮美风光。

你将与脑海中的声音争辩不休，亲眼目睹难以启齿的暴行，跋涉渡河，添置一件气派的新外套，把自己的脑袋伸进绞索，或许——只是或许——还能说出几句颇具哲理的深刻名言。

[摘自[url=https://xavibell.itch.io/trail-of-the-wretched]itch.io[/url]]
